I prefer Option A. Automatic copies best support the goal of not losing something later, because I won’t have to remember to request one for every bookmark. Please include a Settings option to turn automatic copying off, while keeping “Save a copy” available manually.

The saved copy should be self-contained so it still works without relying on the live page. Saving a PDF as the PDF itself is correct, and sending something to the Internet Archive should remain a separate, explicit action.
